hypotheses.reasoning: notification-svc heap after full GC climbs 78%→84%→90% with GC overhead rising (old gen not reclaimed), then OutOfMemoryError at messageCache.put and OOMKilled (2Gi limit) on pods -2, -0, -1 one after another. Each restart leaves no healthy upstream for a while, so the gateway returns 502 'connection reset (no healthy upstream)' in bursts. That matches the intermittent pattern. The heap growth started before the notif-worker deploy (#145), and the notif-db slow audit query (#164) and the 429 throttle (#170) don't explain it.
notif-worker v4.19.9 rolled out at 23:04:53, but heap pressure in notification-svc began at 23:01. It's a different service and came after onset, so it is unlikely to be the cause.

verdict.recommendedAction: Short term: raise the notification-svc memory limit or heap, and/or cap messageCache (size or TTL eviction) so the pods stop crash-looping. Take a heap dump before the next OOM to confirm what messageCache is holding (unbounded growth or a leak), then ship a fix that bounds the cache. Also stagger restarts and check readiness so that at least one healthy upstream stays up.
